messages:
marta: Heads-up: onboarding sampleapp is flaky on the embeddings+rerank flow. Node SDK sometimes returns a different top-level key and occasionally an extra all-zero vector after auth-retry, causing our retriever to blow up.

marta: Repro: local run, batch of 5 inputs, node sdk 0.8.x. Logged response: 
```json
{"vectors": [[0.01,0.02,...],[...],[...],[...],[...]], "meta": {"dim": 1536}}
```

marta: But sometimes the array length is 6 for 5 inputs (trailing zero vector). Python SDK returns `embeddings` and never pads.

raj: Can you paste the exact request and headers?

marta: POST /v1/embeddings?model=redwood-embed-lite
Authorization: Bearer expired-test-token
Body: {"input": ["a","b","c","d","e"]} — client auto-refresh triggers and a retry occurs.

sam: Instrumented the batch helper. On retry path it does `batch.push(zeroVec)` before re-sending instead of cloning snapshot. So it mutates the original array, causing the extra vector.

olivia: Two fixes: 1) SDK response normalization (map `vectors` -> `embeddings`) so consumers are shielded from server/key differences. 2) Batch helper must clone the batch for retry (e.g., `const retryBatch = batch.slice()`), never mutate the original.

raj: Short-term workaround for sampleapp: normalize after response: 
```js
const out = res.embeddings || res.vectors || []
const normalized = out.slice(0, inputs.length)
```

ci-bot: sampleapp CI: test "embed-onboard" flaky -> failing due to extra vector length mismatch.

devex-bot: Created DEVEX-5072: "node-sdk: normalize embeddings key + prevent retry padding" (assigned to olivia).

olivia: I'll pick up DEVEX-5072. Plan: add response normalizer, patch batch helper to snapshot on retry, add unit/e2e test simulating 401+refresh to assert lengths match, and publish 0.8.6.

sam: add a short-lived metric devex.embed.length_mismatch count and a staging alert so we can catch any server regressions too.

marta: pushed tiny sampleapp adapter & test so onboarding CI is stable: https://git.redwood.ai/sampleapp/pull/256

olivia: once I have the SDK patch I'll link the PR and release notes here. Thanks for catching this early — helps avoid a lot of onboarding pain. :thumbsup:
